_context.crumbs.brain: Name of the feature: the shared knowledge of a workspace (pages, files, database). Kept as a product name.
_context.crumbs.company: Section of the Brain holding the company identity pages.
_context.proposals.accepted: Toast after accepting a proposal. {title} is the title of the page that was updated.
_context.proposals.open: Button of the toast: opens the updated page.
_context.proposals.bylineCreate: {name} is the coworker's name; <page></page> is replaced by a tag showing the title of the page it wants to create.
_context.proposals.bylineEdit: {name} is the coworker's name; <page></page> is replaced by a tag showing the title of the page it wants to change.
_context.proposals.basedOn: {sources} is a comma-separated list of where the facts come from (Web search, LinkedIn page...).
_context.proposals.now: Column title, uppercase: what the page says today.
_context.proposals.after: Column title, uppercase: what the page will say once the proposal is accepted.
_context.proposals.intro: Name of the untitled first section of a page.
_context.page.edited: Save status in the top bar. {time} is a short relative time such as 5m or 2d.
_context.page.lastEditedValue: {time} is a short relative time such as 5m; {author} is who edited the page.
_context.page.conflict: {name} is who changed the page (a person or a coworker), or Someone.
_context.page.more: Icon button opening a menu of more actions.
_context.history.versionFrom: {date} is a full date and time.
_context.history.currentShort: In the list of versions: the version the page shows now.
_context.history.authorFromProposal: {author} is who wrote that version; it came from an accepted proposal.
_context.newPage.linkHint: {slug} is the page identifier, shown as the wiki link coworkers write.
_context.editor.slash.pageLinkHint: Under the Link to page command: typing [[ does the same thing.
_context.workspace.seedingTitle: Rerun is reading the company's website to fill the Brain.
_context.workspace.missingPageTitle: {slug} is the page identifier a link pointed to.
_context.workspace.missingTableTitle: {name} is the table name a link pointed to.
_context.sources.dns: A source of facts about the company: its email DNS records (MX, SPF).
_context.sources.stack: A source of facts: the tools detected on the company's website (analytics, CRM...).
_context.sources.registry: A source of facts: the official register of companies.
_context.authors.seed: Author of a page Rerun filled by reading the company's website.
_context.authors.foreman: Author of a page written by Rerun's own assistant coworker.
_context.proposals.headlineEdit: Title of a card proposing a change to a Brain page (the company's knowledge base). {title} is the page name.

workspace.unreachableFallback: Could not reach the machine of this workspace.
workspace.noMachineTitle: Your Brain comes with your first coworker
workspace.noMachineDescription: It lives on your workspace's machine, which is set up when Rerun builds your first coworker. From then on, what every coworker knows about your company, and the files and tables they share, show up here.
workspace.unreachableDescription: The machine of this workspace did not answer. It may still be waking up.
workspace.seedingDescription: The identity card of your company shows up here in a few minutes: what you sell, to whom, your team, your voice and your tools.
workspace.emptyDescription: It is what every coworker reads about your company before it works: what you sell, to whom, your team, your voice and your tools. Rerun can fill it from your website.
workspace.missingPageDescription: A link points here, but nothing has been written on this page.
workspace.missingTableDescription: It may have been deleted, or the coworker that mentioned it has not created it yet.
